finding.message: src/session.js isSessionValid: the window is computed as SESSION_LIFETIME * 1000 * 1000. SESSION_LIFETIME is already in seconds, so the extra factor of 1000 makes the window about 20.8 days (1,800,000,000 ms) instead of 30 minutes (1,800,000 ms). Expired sessions are reported valid, which breaks R1. Fix: use SESSION_LIFETIME * 1000.
